newsitem.title: Austria: Austrian shares close down as CA sale looms.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close down as CA sale looms.

text.p: 1330 GMT - Austrian shares close lower after volatile trading day overshadowed by looming sale of state's stake in flagship bank Creditanstalt, expected to be announced Friday.
Traders say outlook remains uncertain but see strong resistance in ATX at 1,130 points.
* ATX index down 7.06 points or 0.62 points at 1,130.22
* January ATX future down 6.8 points at 1,129.7
* Creditanstalt preference shares down one percent after bank reports after bank reports 20 percent rise in preliminary 1996 net profit
* EA-Generali, leading a consortium of bidders for Creditnastalt whose chances of success are seen as increasingly slim, tops day's decliners and falls 3.23 percent to 3,000 ATS
* Vienna Bourse index down 2.07 points or 0.48 percent at 425.56 -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
